title: Grateful Dead Live at Hartford Civic Center on 1988-04-04
lineage: MAC playback on azimuth adjusted Nakamich CR-7A > Lynx RCA-XLR cables > Lunatec V3 (96KHz) > AES/EBU digital out > LynxTwo Soundcard, Pro-mode Sync > recorded to harddrive with Wavelab 5 as 24 bit/96 KHz PCM WAV > Waves Z-Noise and Ozone 3  > MBIT+ > 16/44.1 >  CDWAV 1.9 > FLAC (level 8).
source: Tapers section, Sennheiser ME88s > Sony D5.  Master Analog Cassettes Maxell MX90 Type IV cassettes.

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience tape of an intense 1988 show featuring a soaring Stella Blue, epic The Other One and a standout Dear Mr. Fantasy.
ai_review.review: The recording is a well‑balanced audience capture that lets the raw energy of the night shine through.  Fans praise Jerry’s impassioned performance despite vocal strain, highlighting a transcendent Stella Blue, an adventurous Other One and an inspired Dear Mr. Fantasy.  Overall the show feels intense and memorable.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers are highly positive; the show is described as intense with several standout moments, and the audience tape is called excellent and well‑balanced.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Well‑balanced audience mix with clear instrument separation; no reported dropouts or muffiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy flow with powerful peaks on The Other One and Stella Blue, culminating in an inspired Dear Mr. Fantasy; the intensity never wanes.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Voice was strained but he gave his all and delivered a passionate performance.
